paragraphs: Cozy Catch is a simple game I made where you're supposed to Control a basket move it around and catch fruits and leaves falling off a tree, there's also this evil squirrel trying to knock down and waste stuff so you have to watchout for it too, the games of a 6x6 diagonal grid(i know weird) but it looked unique and the main idea is you trying to catch and save as much stuff so the tree doesnt get discouraged and stop absorbing neutrients, This game was made for the Fall Game Jam 2026 by Myself(Huzaifa)
